factor_basis: Spinoff: v = 18.45% of pre-distribution value allocated to FedEx Freight (FDXF) per issuer Form 8937 (1 FDXF per 2 FDX; VWAPs on 2026-06-01 FDX $336.39, FDXF $152.22). factor = 1/(1-0.1845) = 1.22624157 (computed).
source_quote: Form 8937: "the fair market value of a share of FedEx common stock on June 1, 2026 was $336.39 and the fair market value of a share of FedEx Freight common stock on June 1, 2026 was $152.22. Based on these fair market values and the distribution ratio of one share of FedEx Freight common stock per two shares of FedEx common stock held, shareholders' pre-Distribution tax basis should be apportioned 81.55% to their FedEx common stock and 18.45% to their FedEx Freight common stock." 8-K: "Each FedEx stockholder received one share of FedEx Freight common stock for every two shares of FedEx common stock held of record as of the close of business on May 15, 2026."
notes: Ex date 2026-06-01 is my reading: the regular-way FDX market carried the entitlement through the close of 2026-05-29 (Friday) and FDXF regular-way trading began 2026-06-01. The 8937 uses post-spin VWAPs (a tax basis split), not the last cum close; a strict last-cum-close / ex-open factor would differ slightly. FedEx kept 19.9% of FDXF for later monetization; a future exchange offer or distribution of that stake could be a second event (none found as of 2026-09-28).

factor_basis: Spinoff: v = 4.2% of pre-distribution basis allocated to Kyndryl (KD) per IBM Form 8937 (1 KD per 5 IBM; NYSE closes 2021-11-04 IBM $120.85, KD $26.38). factor = 1/(1-0.042) = 1.04384134 (computed).
source_quote: Form 8937 (scanned; read from rendered page image): "One possible approach is to utilize the New York Stock Exchange market closing price on November 4, 2021, the date on which Kyndryl Holdings stock first traded, (the "Closing Price") as an indication of the fair market value. For IBM common stock the Closing Price was $120.85 per share and for Kyndryl Holdings common stock the Closing Price was $26.38 per share. Based on that approach ... 95.8% of an IBM stockholder's aggregate tax basis ... would be allocated to such shareholder's shares of IBM common stock and 4.2% would be allocated to such shareholder's shares of Kyndryl Holdings common stock". 8-K: "one share of Kyndryl common stock for every five shares of IBM common stock ... owned by IBM's stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 25, 2021."
notes: Issuer rounds to 4.2%. Unrounded from the issuer's own prices: 0.2 x 26.38 / (120.85 + 0.2 x 26.38) = 0.041831 -> factor 1.04365737 (computed); difference ~0.02%. Ex date 2021-11-04 is my reading: the distribution was 'after close of market on November 3, 2021' and KD first traded on 2021-11-04. The PDF is a scanned image; the quote was transcribed from rendered page images, not machine-extracted text.
